headline: Argus Partners advises altM on $10 million Series A fundraise
sum: Alt Material Innovations Private Limited, dba altM, has raised $10.3 million from a Series A fundraise led by Rainmatter by Zerodha and Mela Ventures, with participation from existing investors Omnivore, Theia Ventures, Aureolis Ventures…
detail: Alt Material Innovations Private Limited, dba altM, has raised $10.3 million from a Series A fundraise led by Rainmatter by Zerodha and Mela Ventures, with participation from existing investors Omnivore, Theia Ventures, Aureolis Ventures and Spectrum Impact, along with VC Grid and other strategic angel investors. Argus Partners advised altM on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Anantha Iyer (Partner), with support from Associates Aradhana Pandit, Ashuthosh V and Shruti Walzade. altM altM, founded in 2022 by former Tesla manufacturing leaders Apoorv Garg and Yugal Raj Jain, is developing a specialty chemicals platform that converts agricultural residue into high-performance…
